title: On-board information
slide_intent: Keep identity legible at a personal viewing distance because a traveler must read information in a confined seat environment.
strategic_value: A recognizable blue interface can carry Lufthansa’s identity into the passenger’s immediate experience.
demonstration: A seat-back screen shows Lufthansa identification, a city image, seat 28G and device symbols.
practical_value: Check hierarchy between personal identification and supporting interface information.

content_islands.name: Screen
content_islands.spec: Center the seat-back display with its large seat number.

content_islands.name: Cabin context
content_islands.spec: Retain the surrounding seats to show the viewing environment.
